subject: general
question: Which of the following industries was operational in India at the time of independence?
solution: The correct answer is __**Iron and Steel Industry**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Iron and Steel Industry** was operational in India at the time of independence and played a significant role in the country's early industrial development. • The first integrated steel plant in India, **Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO)**, was established in **1907** in **Jamshedpur**, Jharkhand. • The industry was crucial for the production of essential materials used in infrastructure, transportation, and defense during pre-independence and post-independence periods. • Other steel plants like the **Indian Iron and Steel Company (IISCO)**, established in **1918** in West Bengal, contributed significantly to India's industrial base. • At the time of independence in **1947**, the Iron and Steel Industry was one of the few industries that were developed and functional, laying the foundation for modern industrial growth in India.
